summary.text: This resolution recognizes 2026 as the International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists. It also encourages federal agencies, universities, and organizations across the country to promote education, research, and outreach related to rangeland management.

title: A resolution recognizing 2026 as the "International Year of Rangelands and Pastoralists".
